description: Ex-Marineflieger Breguet Atlantic, c/n 12, gate guardian of the naval air station at Nordholz, from which Marinefliegergeschwader 3 flew the type until 2010. Distinct from the Atlantic inside the neighbouring Aeronauticum museum.
Ex-Marineflieger Dornier Do 228-212, c/n 8185, used for pollution-control maritime surveillance and preserved at Nordholz.
Ex-Marineflieger Sea King Mk 41, c/n WA765, written off on 16 January 1974 and thereafter used as a ground instructional airframe at Nordholz.
Cabin section only of a Marineflieger Sea Lynx Mk 88, c/n 220, used for ground instruction at Nordholz and wearing the false code 83+01 (true identity 83+54).
Cabin section only of a second Marineflieger Sea Lynx Mk 88, c/n 258, used for ground instruction at Nordholz and wearing the false code 83+07 (true identity 83+55).
Ex-United States Navy P-3C-II Orion, c/n 5690, held at Nordholz as a ground instructional airframe and marked with the German code 60+22, which belongs to another aircraft.

F-104G Starfighter preserved on the naval air station at Nordholz, distinct from the Starfighter inside the neighbouring Aeronauticum museum. Recorded by the International F-104 Society survey of preserved German Starfighters; presence not independently re-confirmed by a dated photograph.
